events.location: Ilha da Trindade, South Atlantic (off Brazil)
events.title: UFO photographed from NE Almirante Saldanha off Ilha da Trindade
events.witnesses: Almiro Baraúna; Captain José Teobaldo Viegas; Brazilian Air Force Rot. Commander Carlos Bacellar; Lt. Homero Ribeiro; ship's dentist; several sailors; crew members in the stern and bow; at least 100 later-reported witnesses
events.source: Arquivo Nacional do Brasil · BR DFANBSB ARX.0.0.161 (Ministério da Aeronáutica, Gabinete do Ministro, 1976)
events.record_description: Brazilian National Archive file, Ministry of Aeronautics (Gabinete do Ministro). The file consists of a 1976 release of the Brazilian Navy inquiry, congressional and presidential correspondence, and the formal English-language résumé of the famous 1958 Ilha da Trindade UFO photographic case. Released to the public via Arquivo Nacional / SIAN (Sistema de Informações do Arquivo Nacional).
events.official_location: Ilha da Trindade, South Atlantic (off Brazilian coast)
events.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** On 16 January 1958, the unidentified flying object was seen from the Brazilian Navy training ship NE Almirante Saldanha, anchored off Galo Crest, Trindade Isle. The principal photographer was Almiro Baraúna, a member of the Icarain Club for Submarine Hunting. Other named witnesses included Captain José Teobaldo Viegas of the Brazilian Air Force Reserve, Commander Carlos Bacellar (captain of the ship), Lieutenant Homero Ribeiro, the ship’s dentist, and several sailors. The résumé also states that crew members in the stern and bow later saw the event, and that Baraúna was able to take six photographs, four of which showed the object.

**Sighting:** The report says that around 12:15 hours an UFO alarm was registered aboard the NE Almirante Saldanha while the vessel was anchored close to the island and preparing to depart. The crew was engaged in taking aboard the boat used for trips to the island when the alarm was given simultaneously by men stationed in the stern and bow. On the same occasion, Baraúna, who was on deck photographing the operation, was alerted and had the opportunity to shoot the sequence of images.

**Object:** The object itself is described only as an unidentified aerial object seen over Trindade Isle. The surrounding documents emphasize that the sighting was accompanied by photographs and that the negatives later showed details not obvious in the first inspection. According to Commander Bacellar, the object seen in the photographs was the same one the crew had observed in the air. The negatives were later sent to the Cruzeiro do Sul Aerophotogrammetric Service, where they were analyzed and declared genuine.

**Aftermath:** Immediately after the sighting, Baraúna removed the film from the camera in the presence of Commander Bacellar and other officers; later, together with Bacellar, he went to the ship’s photo-lab dressed only in a shirt and shorts. The processing took about ten minutes, after which the negatives were examined. They were then shown to crew members who had witnessed the phenomenon, and they recognized the object in the photos as identical to the one they had seen. The documents further note that the episode became the subject of Navy inquiry, congressional interest, and press coverage. The naval statement quoted in the file says the Ministry had no reason to prevent disclosure of the photographs, but could not pronounce on the object’s nature because the images did not constitute sufficient proof. The inquiry therefore confirmed the existence of the photographic record and the witness accounts, but stopped short of a definitive identification of the object.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 1958年1月16日，这一不明飞行物是在巴西海军训练舰 NE Almirante Saldanha 上被看到并拍摄到的，该舰当时锚泊在特林达德岛（Ilha da Trindade）外、靠近 Galo Crest。主要摄影者是 Almiro Baraúna，他是 Icarain Club for Submarine Hunting 的成员。文中还点名了其他见证者：巴西空军预备役 José Teobaldo Viegas 上尉、舰长 Carlos Bacellar 指挥官、Homero Ribeiro 中尉、舰上牙医以及几名水手。摘要还说明，舰尾和舰首的船员也看到了这一现象，Baraúna 总共拍摄了六张照片，其中四张拍到了该物体。

**目击：** 报告称大约在 12:15，NE Almirante Saldanha 舰上响起了 UFO 警报。当时军舰停在岛附近，正准备起航，船员们正在把用于往返岛屿的小艇收上船；警报几乎同时由舰尾和舰首的人员发出。就在这一时刻，站在甲板上拍摄作业的 Baraúna 被提醒，并获得了拍摄这一连串影像的机会。

**物体：** 文中对该物体的描述仅为在特林达德岛上空出现的不明空中物体。相关文件强调，这次目击伴随着照片证据，而且底片在初次查看时看不清的一些细节，后来才显现出来。根据 Bacellar 指挥官的说法，照片中的物体与船员在空中看到的那个物体是同一个。随后，这些底片被送往 Cruzeiro do Sul Aerophotogrammetric Service 分析，并被认定为真实。

**后续：** 目击发生后，Baraúna 在 Bacellar 指挥官和其他军官在场的情况下，从相机中取出胶卷；之后他与 Bacellar 一起只穿着衬衫和短裤前往船上的暗房。显影大约持续十分钟，随后底片被检查。之后，这些底片又展示给目击该现象的船员，他们认出照片里的物体与自己当时在空中看到的完全相同。文件还指出，此事引发了海军调查、国会关注以及媒体报道。档案中的海军声明表示，部里没有理由阻止这些照片公开，但由于照片不足以证明该物体的性质，因此无法作出最终判断。调查因此确认了摄影记录和证人陈述的存在，但并未对该物体给出明确身份认定。

events.title: A Noite Oficial dos OVNIs — 21 UFOs tracked by CINDACTA radar, 5 FAB fighters scrambled
events.witnesses: CINDACTA radar operators (flight controller Sérgio Mota); 5 FAB fighter pilots (F-5E from Santa Cruz AB, Mirage IIIE from Anápolis AB); multiple civilian witnesses across four Brazilian states. Press conference 23 May 1986 by Minister of Aeronautics Brig. Octávio Júlio Moreira Lima.
events.source: Government of Brazil (gov.br) — Official press release "Official UFO Night in Brazil", 20 May 2022. Underlying declassified FAB report dated 2 June 1986 (declassified 25 September 2009), signed by interim Air Force commander José Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque.
events.record_description: Brazilian government official press release on gov.br describing the declassified FAB report of the 19-20 May 1986 mass UFO sighting event known as "A Noite Oficial dos OVNIs". The report was declassified by the Ministry of Defence on 25 September 2009 and is the Brazilian government's most public acknowledgement of an unexplained mass radar/visual UAP incident.
events.official_location: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Goiás (Brazil)
events.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Multiple civilian and military observers across four Brazilian states — **São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais and Goiás**. Radar operators at the **Centro Integrado de Defesa Aérea e Controle de Tráfego Aéreo (CINDACTA / Integrated Center for Air Defense and Air Traffic Control)** and at least five Brazilian Air Force (Força Aérea Brasileira / FAB) pilots intercepted the objects in flight. Flight controller **Sérgio Mota** was the operator who first relayed CINDACTA's radar tracks. The FAB pilots and controllers later appeared in person at an official press conference.

**Sighting:** On the evening of **19 May 1986** (continuing into the early hours of 20 May), as many as **21 unidentified flying objects** were tracked simultaneously by FAB radar, civilian air-traffic radar, and visual witnesses on the ground. Some objects were reported to be **up to 100 metres in diameter**. CINDACTA scrambled **five FAB fighter jets** to investigate — including F-5E Tiger II interceptors from Santa Cruz Air Base (Rio de Janeiro) and Mirage IIIE fighters from Anápolis Air Base (Goiás). Several of the pilots obtained visual and radar lock-on contact with the objects, which manoeuvred at speeds and accelerations the pilots described as exceeding the performance envelope of any known aircraft.

**Object:** Multiple bright objects, some appearing as solid discs and others as fast-moving points of light. Radar returns were strong, stable, and tracked on both military and civilian air-traffic radar screens simultaneously — strongly suggesting physical, reflective targets rather than atmospheric anomalies.

**Aftermath:** Four days later, on **23 May 1986 at 16:30**, **Minister of Aeronautics Brigadier Octávio Júlio Moreira Lima** held an official press conference in Brasília, attended by the five FAB pilots and the CINDACTA flight controllers involved. The Minister stated: *"It's not about whether or not you believe [in extraterrestrial beings or flying saucers]. We can only give technical information. There are several assumptions. Technically, I would tell you that we have no explanation."* The formal classified report, dated **2 June 1986** and signed by then-Air Force interim commander **José Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque**, concluded that *"the phenomena are solid and reflect, in a certain way, intelligence."* The report remained classified until it was officially **declassified on 25 September 2009** by the Brazilian Ministry of Defence and released to public archives. The case is widely known in Brazil as **"A Noite Oficial dos OVNIs"** ("The Official UFO Night") — the Brazilian government's most public acknowledgement of an unexplained mass radar/visual UAP incident.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 巴西四个州的众多平民与军方观察者：**圣保罗 (São Paulo)、里约热内卢 (Rio de Janeiro)、米纳斯吉拉斯 (Minas Gerais) 和戈亚斯 (Goiás)**。**综合防空与空中交通管制中心 (CINDACTA)** 的雷达操作员、以及至少五名巴西空军 (FAB) 飞行员在飞行中拦截了这些物体。空中交通管制员**Sérgio Mota** 是首位通报 CINDACTA 雷达轨迹的人员。事件后，FAB 飞行员与管制员一同出席官方新闻发布会。

**目击：** **1986 年 5 月 19 日**傍晚（持续至 5 月 20 日凌晨），FAB 军用雷达、民用空管雷达以及地面目击者同时追踪到**多达 21 个不明飞行物**。其中一些据报**直径达到 100 米**。CINDACTA 紧急派出 **5 架 FAB 战斗机**进行拦截——包括从里约热内卢 Santa Cruz 空军基地起飞的 F-5E Tiger II 型拦截机，以及从戈亚斯 Anápolis 空军基地起飞的 Mirage IIIE 战斗机。多名飞行员获得了对目标的目视与雷达锁定接触，他们形容这些物体的机动速度与加速度超出了任何已知飞行器的性能极限。

**物体：** 多个明亮物体——部分呈实心圆盘状，其余呈快速移动的光点。雷达回波强烈、稳定，并同时被军用与民用空管雷达屏幕追踪——强烈表明这些是具有物理反射特性的目标，而非大气异常。

**后续：** 四天后，**1986 年 5 月 23 日下午 4:30**，**航空部长 Octávio Júlio Moreira Lima 准将**在巴西利亚召开官方新闻发布会，五名 FAB 飞行员与 CINDACTA 管制员出席。部长表示：*"问题不在于你是否相信[外星人或飞碟]。我们只能提供技术信息。存在多种假设。从技术上讲，我可以告诉你——我们没有解释。"* 由时任空军临时总司令 **José Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque** 签署、日期为 **1986 年 6 月 2 日**的正式机密报告得出结论：*"这些现象是具体的，并在某种程度上反映出智能性。"* 该报告一直处于机密状态，直至 **2009 年 9 月 25 日**由巴西国防部正式解密，公开归档。本事件在巴西广为人知，被称为 **"A Noite Oficial dos OVNIs"（官方 UFO 之夜）**——是巴西政府对一次无法解释的大规模雷达／目视 UAP 事件最公开的官方承认。
